First name the sport.” with the reply starting “The sport is” (model continues: “polo. Each team has **”). Remove “polo” in layers 12–23 → P(“polo”) goes 0.66 → 0.65. Drop 0.01.

asks: Does removing the bridge, before the answer onset, kill the answer?
what_happened: Remove “polo” in layers 0–11 → P(“Four”) goes 0.45 → 0.37. Drop 0.19.

asks: Is that drop bigger than removing everyday words of the same strength?
what_happened: Biggest drop from 12 everyday words: 0.28 (“jacket”, layers 12–23). Bridge 0.19 − noise 0.28 = -0.09 (pass ≥ 0.5).

asks: Does the bridge start to matter at least 3 layers before the answer does?
what_happened: Removing “polo” never drops P by 0.5 in any window; the answer “Four” matters from layer 24.

asks: Does removing the bridge matter more than removing another word of the same kind (another city, another animal)?
what_happened: Remove “golf” (same kind) → P(“Four”) goes 0.45 → 0.39. Drop 0.13. Bridge 0.19 − 0.13 = 0.06 (pass ≥ 0.3).

asks: Does the same edit leave unrelated questions alone?
what_happened: Same edit (layers 0–11): “What is the chemical symbol for gold? Answer in one word.” → P(“Au”) 0.80 → 0.53; “What is the largest planet in the Solar System? Answer in one word.” → P(“Jupiter”) 0.38 → 0.18. Biggest drop 0.52 (pass ≤ 0.1).

asks: What if the bridge is removed over many layers at once?
what_happened: Remove “polo” in layers 16–47 → P(“Four”) 0.45 → 0.39 (drop 0.14); in all layers → 0.34 (drop 0.25).

test: 7b · Bridge's own part vs its kind (reported)
asks: Remove only the part of the bridge NOT shared with any same-kind word: does the answer still collapse?
what_happened: Remove “polo” minus “hockey” + “golf” (early layers) → P(“Four”) 0.45 → 0.43. Drop 0.05.

asks: Does removing only the part of the bridge not shared with the answer still kill it?
what_happened: Remove “polo” minus “Four” (early layers) → P(“Four”) 0.45 → 0.42. Drop 0.06.

asks: Swap in another word: does the answer become that word's answer?
what_happened: 0 of 4 swaps gave the swapped word's own answer (fallback answer with the bridge removed: “4”).

asks: Swap in a word with the same answer: is the answer kept?
what_happened: No same-answer swap word available.

asks: Need × specificity × isolation (0 if the bridge doesn't come first)
what_happened: Need 0.00 (drop beyond noise) × specificity 0.25 (share left when only the bridge's own part, not shared with same-kind words, is removed) × isolation 0.33 (share left when the part shared with the answer is kept) = 0.00 → 0 because the bridge doesn't act before the answer.
